# apollonian-sandpile-markov (0TH-2026-018)

> Zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 six-kernel formalization of 15 headline theorems unifying Apollonian/Octahedral reciprocity obstructions, Triangular Lattice A2 Even-Laplacian Sandpile Rigidity, and Markov-Hurwitz Mod-32 & 5-step Cluster Laurent positivity.

## Canonical Files
- [README.md](README.md): Overview, verbatim 5-second Lean axiom audit, quickstart
- [CLAIMS.md](CLAIMS.md): Complete theorem-to-declaration claims matrix and open boundaries
- [LIMITATIONS.md](LIMITATIONS.md): Scope limits and 6 concrete falsification criteria
- [VERIFICATION.md](VERIFICATION.md): Six-kernel Lean + Rust + C11 ASan/UBSan + Python/Hypothesis/mutation architecture
- [REPLICATION.md](REPLICATION.md): Clean-clone step-by-step reproduction guide
- [HARDENING_LOG.md](HARDENING_LOG.md): 3-cycle audit log across all 10 finding classes
